newsitem.title: USA: World Bank lends Haiti $12 mln for public sector.
newsitem.headline: World Bank lends Haiti $12 mln for public sector.

text.p: The World Bank said Wednesday its soft-loan arm, the International Development Association, would lend Haiti $12 million to boost public finances, increase private participation in public enterprises and give a foundation to public sector reforms.

It said in a statement that despite 4.5 percent GDP growth, inflation dropping to 17 percent from 52 and recovery in the gourde to 14.5 to the dollar from 20, the government still faced "debilitated institutions, large macroeconomic imbalances, depleted productive assets, dilapidated infrastructure and environment and pervasive poverty."
The loan is for 40 years with a 0.50 percent commitment fee on undisbursed credit balances, it said.
